title: Vegetarian Pasta Bake
description: A hearty vegetarian pasta bake with roasted Mediterranean vegetables in a rich tomato sauce, finished with a cheesy panko crust. Serves 4 at roughly 650 calories per serving.

ingredients.name: Olive oil
ingredients.note: Most goes into frying the aubergine.

ingredients.name: Fresh basil
ingredients.note: Leaves and stems are both used — the stems go into the sauce.

equipment.name: Frying pan
equipment.note: Large enough to hold all the vegetables and sauce.

equipment.name: Grater
equipment.note: Not needed if your cheese is already grated.

equipment.name: Mug or cup
equipment.note: For scooping out pasta water before draining.

equipment.name: Kettle
equipment.note: To speed up boiling the pasta water.

stages.label: Preparation
stages.description: Chop, pick, and measure everything into separate containers before any heat goes on.

steps.instruction: Crush and dice the {1} of garlic. Set aside in a small container.
Chop the aubergine into bite-sized pieces. Set aside in a container.
Chop the red onion. Set aside in a separate container.
Chop the {1} and {2} into bite-sized pieces. Set them aside together in a separate container.
Pick the leaves from the basil and set them aside in a container.
Finely chop the basil stems and set them aside in a separate container.
steps.hint: The stems carry plenty of flavour and go into the sauce; the leaves are saved for the topping and garnish.

steps.instruction: Fill and switch on the kettle for the pasta water.
Measure out {1} of penne pasta.
Open the tin of cherry tomatoes so it's ready to pour.

stages.label: Cooking — Pasta & Sauce
stages.description: The pasta cooks in parallel while you build the vegetable sauce on the hob — the app will manage the timing for you.

steps.instruction: Heat {1} of olive oil in the frying pan over low–medium heat.
Add the aubergine and stir well to coat it in the oil. Let it fry, stirring occasionally.
Return the fried aubergine to its container. Try to keep as much oil in the pan as possible — if needed, tip a little oil back from the container into the pan.
Tip the onions into the pan and let them cook.
Stir in the peppers and courgettes.
Add the garlic and stir.
Stir in the tomato puree.
Add the cooked aubergine, the tin of cherry tomatoes, the basil stems, and half the basil leaves. Bring to a gentle simmer.
steps.actionLabel: Sauce is at a gentle simmer
steps.completionHint: Small bubbles breaking gently across the surface — not a vigorous boil.

steps.instruction: Let the sauce simmer gently.
Stir in {1} of salt and {2} of black pepper, then take the pan off the heat.
steps.actionLabel: Sauce is seasoned and off the heat

steps.instruction: Pour the boiled kettle water into the saucepan and bring it back to the boil. Add the penne and give it a stir.
The pasta cooks in the background while you get on with the sauce. You'll be alerted when the timer is up.
steps.hint: 8 minutes suits most penne, but check your pack and adjust the timer if needed — aim to take it off about 2 minutes before the stated time, as it finishes cooking in the oven.

steps.instruction: Drain the pasta, but first scoop out a mugful of the cooking water and keep it to one side.
steps.completionHint: The pasta should still be firm with a bite.
steps.hint: The reserved water is starchy and thick — it will help thicken the sauce later.

stages.label: Preparation — Topping
stages.description: Heat the oven and mix the cheesy breadcrumb topping while the sauce rests.

steps.instruction: Heat the oven to 180°C fan.
steps.hint: If your oven isn't fan-assisted, set it to 200°C instead.

steps.instruction: Measure {1} of panko breadcrumbs into a large container.
Grate (or measure, if pre-grated) {1} of hard cheese, {2} of mozzarella, and {3} of mature cheddar into the same container as the breadcrumbs.
Add {1} of black pepper to the mixture.
Stir the breadcrumbs and cheese together until roughly mixed.

stages.label: Assemble & Bake
stages.description: Combine the pasta and sauce, top with the cheesy breadcrumbs, and bake.

steps.instruction: Mix the cooked pasta and sauce together, loosening it with a generous splash of the reserved pasta water.

generous splash.title: How much pasta water?
generous splash.text: Start with about half a mug. The starchy water loosens the sauce and helps it cling to the pasta — add more a little at a time if it looks dry.

steps.instruction: Taste and season with more salt and pepper if you like.
Tip the pasta into the ovenproof dish and spread it out evenly.
Spread the cheese and breadcrumb mixture evenly over the top of the pasta.
Bake in the oven.
Turn the dish around for even browning, then bake for a further 5 minutes.
steps.completionHint: The topping should be golden and crisp.

steps.instruction: Garnish with the remaining basil leaves, if you're feeling posh, and serve.
